name: Smile Dental Clinic

summary_en: Located in Bangkok, Smile Dental Clinic holds a 4.5 rating based on 4 reviews with a trust score of 52.2. The clinic has been mentioned in 8 Pantip discussions, though the referenced titles indicate potential variations in clinic naming conventions.
